facts.text: Raffles Udaipur is set on a 21-acre private island.
facts.excerpt: Set on a 21-acre private island rich with birdlife and exotic flora and fauna

facts.text: Raffles Udaipur is the first Raffles hotel in India.
facts.excerpt: this contemporary reimagining of a country mansion is the first Raffles hotel in India

facts.text: Raffles Udaipur opened in 2021.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Udaipur opened in 2021

facts.text: The resort spans a private island and a lakeshore, and stays begin with a boat ride.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Udaipur spans a private island and serene lakeshore. Begin your journey with a graceful boat ride

facts.text: The resort is 20 minutes from the airport.
facts.excerpt: Just 20 minutes from the airport

facts.text: A limousine takes guests from the airport to a lakeside pavilion, where a private boat transfer waits.
facts.excerpt: Our luxurious limousine service will whisk you seamlessly from the airport to our lakeside pavilion where your private boat transfer awaits.

facts.text: The principal building is inspired by classical European Palladian architecture, with domes and high ceilings, surrounded by Baroque gardens.
facts.excerpt: The structure of the principal building is inspired by classical European Palladian architecture, featuring domes and high ceilings, and surrounded by beautiful Baroque gardens.

facts.text: Local Mewari elements such as jali panels and Tikri artwork appear in the design.
facts.excerpt: Local Mewari elements such as jali panels and the iconic Tikri artwork further showcase this stunning blend of two distinct geographies.

facts.text: Public spaces, rooms and suites hold a curated selection of Indian artwork, including prints and original paintings by Thomas Daniell RA.
facts.excerpt: Look out for prints and original paintings by Thomas Daniell RA

facts.text: All rooms have a balcony with lake views; many have a private pool, a garden or both.
facts.excerpt: All have a generous balcony with breathtaking lake views; many have a private pool, a beautifully manicured garden or both.

facts.text: Every suite has a panoramic view of the lake.
facts.excerpt: Every suite has a panoramic view of the lake and is a veritable palace in its own right

facts.text: Lakeshore Accommodation is in non-island Lakeshore residences overlooking Udai Sagar Lake, with access to island dining and experiences.
facts.excerpt: Set within the tranquil non-island Lakeshore residences, Lakeshore Accommodation at Raffles Udaipur offers refined rooms and suites overlooking Udai Sagar Lake.

facts.text: Raffles Butlers are available 24 hours a day.
facts.excerpt: our Raffles Butlers are on hand 24 hours a day to elevate your experience

facts.text: Sawai Kitchen serves rediscovered heirloom recipes from the Rajputana royal households, using local seasonal produce and traditional cooking techniques.
facts.excerpt: Rediscovered heirloom recipes from the Rajputana royal households are lovingly prepared by blending local seasonal produce with traditional cooking techniques.

facts.text: Raffles Spa offers ayurveda-inspired healing practices alongside contemporary wellness treatments.
facts.excerpt: offering an impeccable blend of ayurveda-inspired healing practices and contemporary wellness treatments

facts.text: The spa's Presidential Couples Suite has a steam area, sauna, Jacuzzi and a private balcony overlooking the lake.
facts.excerpt: the Presidential Couples Suite, featuring a steam area, sauna, Jacuzzi and private balcony overlooking the lake

facts.text: Island activities include cricket, archery, shooting, wall-climbing and mountain biking.
facts.excerpt: From cricket and country pursuits, such as archery and shooting, to wall-climbing and mountain biking

facts.text: The Voyagers Den offers badminton, table tennis, pool, board games, PS 5 and croquet.
facts.excerpt: Badminton, Table tennis, pool, board games, PS 5, croquet are offered in the Voyagers Den.

facts.text: A naturalist leads guided morning bird walks to spot resident and migratory birds.
facts.excerpt: Discover the rich birdlife of Raffles Udaipur on a guided morning walk with our naturalist. Spot resident and migratory birds

facts.text: Evenings can begin with an Evening Aarti by Udai Sagar Lake, followed by folk music and traditional dance performances.
facts.excerpt: Experience the soul of Rajasthan as your evening begins with the serene Evening Aarti by Udai Sagar Lake, followed by vibrant folk music and traditional dance performances

facts.text: Barefoot Gardening in the Prana Garden is offered with the hotel's compliments.
facts.excerpt: Walk barefoot through the Prana Garden, prepare the soil, sow seasonal seeds and discover the mindful joy of nurturing plants. Offered with our compliments.

facts.text: With the Butler, guests can explore the City Palace and cruise across Lake Pichola to Jag Mandir.
facts.excerpt: Explore the grandeur of the City Palace, cruise across Lake Pichola to Jag Mandir

facts.text: Raffles Udaipur is certified by Green Key.
facts.excerpt: Certified by Green Key, Raffles Udaipur stands as a testament to our enduring commitment to sustainability

facts.text: The hotel was named a 2 Key Michelin Guide Hotel in the Michelin Key Guide Awards 2026.
facts.excerpt: Michelin Key Guide Awards 2026 - 2 Key Michelin Guide Hotel

facts.text: The ideal time to visit is September to March, when the weather is pleasant for outdoor activities.
facts.excerpt: The ideal time is from September to March when the weather is pleasant for outdoor activities and sightseeing.

facts.text: A walking trek leads to the Mahadev Temple in the Aravalli Hills, described as 400 years old.
facts.excerpt: Or perhaps a walking trek to the 400-year-old Mahadev Temple in the Aravalli Hills.

facts.text: Butler excursions include the Mahadev Temple in the Aravallis, described as 450 years old.
facts.excerpt: visit the 450-year-old Mahadev Temple nestled in the Aravallis

facts.text: Suites have a manicured garden and a private plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: luxurious furnishings, a manicured garden and private plunge pool

contradictions.note: p5 says the Mahadev Temple is 400 years old, p6 says 450 years old

sources.excerpt: the 400-year-old Mahadev Temple in the Aravalli Hills
the 450-year-old Mahadev Temple nestled in the Aravallis
